questions.question: How should we handle the release with open review findings?

options.label: Release on the planned date
options.description: Release on the planned date and list the open review findings in the release notes.

options.label: Fix critical findings, then release this week
options.description: Hold the release a few days to repair only the high-severity review findings.

options.label: Fix every finding before any release
options.description: Delay the release until all review findings are fixed and verified by a full retest.

options.label: Release gradually to a small user group
options.description: Ship the build to a small share of users first, watch crash and error reports, and widen the rollout in steps.
